svg.title: Derived search projections
svg.desc: Two corpora are projected into PostgreSQL: the memory corpus of each principal and the transcripts of durable chat-facing sessions. Each is projected by a projection class into a lexical chunk table; in hybrid mode a VectorSynchronizer embeds the chunks into a vector table. Live writes, startup reconciliation and dartclaw rebuild-index keep the rows current; none of them changes the canonical files.

g.text: Hover a stage for what it projects and how it recovers; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: DATA FLOW · CANONICAL FILES TO SEARCH ROWS
Search rows are projections of canonical files. They are rebuilt from the sources, never the other way round.

g.text: validated Markdown corpus of one workspace
canonical memory corpus · validated canonical memory of one principal; only topic, archive, observation and learning entries are projected
MEMORY.md, errors.md and MEMORY.audit.md are never indexed, and wiki/ is read in place, so it has no PostgreSQL projection.
MemoryIndexProjection · documents(corpus) makes one chunked SearchDocument per entry, with role, provenance, entry_id and entry_revision
packages/dartclaw_core/lib/src/memory/memory_index_projection.dart. Live writes call it from a post-commit hook registered on the corpus.
memory_chunks · PostgresFtsIndex over memory_chunks; the text-search configuration is database.fts_language
Rows are scoped by user_id (owner or agent:<id>). After a language change, restart and run dartclaw rebuild-index.
memory_vectors · PostgresVectorIndex: transactional mutations; ranking scoped by user_id and filtered to the query fingerprint and dimension
VectorSynchronizer reuses a vector only if content hash and provider fingerprint match, and refuses a late result whose source changed.
messages.ndjson · transcripts of durable user, main, channel and archive sessions; temporary conversations are never indexed
Only user and assistant messages the ConversationState shows are projected; queued, held or removed input is excluded.
ConversationIndexProjection · one document and one chunk per user or assistant message that ConversationState.includesMessage shows
ConversationIndexer, an observer of MessageService and SessionService, keeps it current on one serialized chain; archival keeps the rows.
user_id = pinned workspace principal or owner
conversation_chunks · PostgresFtsIndex over conversation_chunks; rows use the principal pinned on the session, or owner when it has none
A session that crosses the chat-facing boundary gains or loses its rows; deleting or clearing a session removes them.
conversation_vectors · PostgresVectorIndex over conversation_vectors, fed by its own VectorSynchronizer
An embedding failure leaves the lexical index current; a changed provider or model makes earlier vectors ineligible until reconciled.
memory: post-commit hook on the corpus
live writes · memory writes re-project through a post-commit hook; conversation rows follow MessageService and SessionService
A failed projection marks the index degraded or is logged; it never fails the write or message persistence. Later rebuilds reconcile missed work.
stale or degraded: rebuild that principal
startup reconcile · ensureCurrentBatched compares the canonical revision and fingerprint with .dartclaw-memory-index.json
Health is healthy, degraded, rebuilding or unknown; an interrupted rebuilding reads as degraded. Conversation follows a memory rebuild.
dartclaw rebuild-index · run with DartClaw stopped: each principal's memory rows are populated, validated and swapped in one transaction
Conversation rows are cleared, then repopulated, so a crash can leave them partial until rerun. NDJSON, wiki pages and KG facts are never changed.
